title: Human-inspired, Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration for Efficient Learning in High Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2609.36672v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient exploration in high-dimensional decision spaces remains a central challenge for decision-making systems. Humans, in contrast, can navigate large decision spaces with remarkable efficiency. Recent behavioral studies suggest that humans reduce dimensionality in large decision spaces by probing candidate feature dimensions, identifying reward-relevant ones, and restricting the effective decision space. Inspired by this mechanism, we propose TDGE (Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration), a human-inspired, model-agnostic algorithm with an automatically constructed task-dimension--feature--item hierarchy. TDGE follows a top-down exploration strategy: it first selects task-relevant feature dimensions, then identifies informative features within those dimensions, and finally recommends concrete items based on the selected features. translated_title: 受人类启发的任务维度引导探索，实现高维空间中的高效学习
translated_abstract: 高维决策空间中的高效探索仍然是决策系统的核心挑战。相比之下，人类能够以极高的效率在大型决策空间中进行导航。近期的行为研究表明，人类通过探测候选特征维度、识别与奖励相关的维度，进而限制有效决策空间的方式，来降低大型决策空间的维度。受这一机制启发，我们提出了TDGE（任务维度引导探索），这是一种受人类启发、模型无关的算法，具有自动构建的任务—维度—特征—条目层级结构。TDGE遵循自顶向下的探索策略：首先选择与任务相关的特征维度，然后在这些维度中识别信息丰富的特征，最后基于所选特征推荐具体的条目。在MovieLens-20M、Last.fm和Amazon推荐数据集上的实验表明，TDGE显著提升了探索效率。
tldr: 受人类通过降维来高效决策的机制启发，提出模型无关的TDGE算法，采用自顶向下的任务维度引导探索策略实现高维决策空间的高效学习，并在多个推荐数据集上取得显著提升。
en_tdlr: Inspired by humans' dimensionality-reduction mechanism in decision-making, TDGE is a model-agnostic algorithm that employs a top-down, task-dimension-guided exploration strategy to enable efficient learning in high-dimensional decision spaces, achieving substantial improvements on multiple recommendation datasets.
